$Comment: SCOPE-3 DEV SPIKE, throwaway (design decisions 6/17 + 62): the standing-mount (Hold.Mount.Surface: 'Entity') verify PREP the Anvil arc deferred - the entity-mount machinery (StationEntityMountController, phase-2 leg D + the round-3 NetworkId/CommandBuffer-despawn fixes) was built and unit-tested but never confirmed in-game. Self-contained (no Parent reuse, to keep this spike trivially reviewable) - mirrors the shipped Sawmill's Work/Recipe/Custody shape (same easily-obtainable WoodPlanks input, no Tool requirement so no hatchet is needed either) with ONLY the Hold.Mount group swapped from Block/Seats to Entity/Offset. DECISION-62 CONFIRM KIT (2026-07-28): the first live run proved the mount ATTACHES and holds (session survived the 1s heartbeat, outputs produced) but renders NOTHING - by design, since a working Entity mount sends no visual signal and this spike authors no Camera/Animation/Puppet. This revision adds the Camera group (third person, so the runner can see their own body's position/drift) and Entity.VisibleAnchorItemId (the anchor wears a dropped-item-style marker); run /mount check while engaged for the direct native attach read. Delete this file (+ its Item/RootInteraction pair) once the confirm run settles the mechanism; nothing else in the mod references it.
